rubrics.justification: It correctly interprets the provided Gardner 2AA components, but no image was available and it adds speculative morphology such as lack of zona thinning and developmental delay beyond the supplied data.
It integrates age, BMI, PCOS, ovarian response, semen parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status well, though some links to embryo competence and receptivity are somewhat generalized.
The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible prognosis estimate, though some quantitative adjustments are heuristic and a few claims are more assertive than the data support.

SET recommendation and general prognosis are guideline-concordant, but suggestions such as routine PGT-A in future cycles, ERA after limited failure, and serum progesterone checks/extended support are not universally guideline-based for this profile.
It gives clear practical recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, but some proposed next steps are broader than necessary for a favorable first-cycle patient.
